description.zh: 通过 MCP 接入 Postiz，向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、TikTok、YouTube 等渠道排期、起草和发布。
description.en: Connects to Postiz over MCP to schedule, draft and publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more.

setup.zh: 需要自建 Postiz 实例（Docker 部署，见 https://docs.postiz.com ；官方云服务收费）。部署后在 Postiz 设置里生成 API key，再在插件设置中填写实例地址和 key。
setup.en: Requires a self-hosted Postiz instance (Docker, see https://docs.postiz.com; the official cloud is paid). Create an API key in Postiz settings, then enter the instance URL and key in the plugin settings.

description.zh: 网页搜索、X 搜索与网页抓取，默认使用 Firecrawl/Keenable 的免 key 共享额度。
description.en: Web search, X search and page fetching that defaults to the keyless shared Firecrawl/Keenable quota.

description.zh: 多引擎搜索与结果缓存，覆盖 YouTube、Reddit、Twitter、RSS 等通道。
description.en: Multi-engine search with caching, covering YouTube, Reddit, Twitter and RSS channels.

description.zh: 跨 Web、X、Reddit、YouTube 并行调研，并生成带来源核验的长篇研报。
description.en: Runs parallel research across the web, X, Reddit and YouTube and writes long-form reports with source checks.

setup.zh: 深度研究需要 Tavily API key：到 https://app.tavily.com 注册免费档获取 key，然后在插件设置中填写。
setup.en: Deep research needs a Tavily API key: sign up for the free tier at https://app.tavily.com and enter the key in the plugin settings.

description.zh: 读取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索结果与用户资料。
description.en: Reads Hacker News rankings, threads, search results and user profiles.

description.zh: RSS 订阅、播客转录与文章改写，用于选题监听。
description.en: RSS subscriptions, podcast transcription and article rewriting for topic monitoring.

steps.zh:
1. 打开 **插件** 页，点 **添加插件**，填入 `github:joeseesun/qiaomu-rss-dsh`（该包不在 DSH 插件目录中，需从 GitHub 直接安装）。
2. 重启 Tomato 或刷新插件页确认已启用。
steps.en:
1. Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, and enter `github:joeseesun/qiaomu-rss-dsh` (the package is not in the DSH plugin index, so it installs straight from GitHub).
2. Restart Tomato or reload the Plugins page to confirm it is enabled.

description.zh: 把本地视频或 yt-dlp 链接压成带时间码和台词的宫格图，让纯文本模型也能“看”视频。
description.en: Turns a local video or yt-dlp link into timestamped contact sheets with dialogue so text-only models can read it.

setup.zh: 需要本机已安装 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp：macOS 运行 `brew install ffmpeg yt-dlp`，其他系统见 https://ffmpeg.org 与 https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation 。
setup.en: Requires ffmpeg and yt-dlp on the machine: on macOS run `brew install ffmpeg yt-dlp`; other systems see https://ffmpeg.org and https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation.

description.zh: 检测并下载 YouTube 等平台的视频，分析画质和格式。
description.en: Detects and downloads videos from YouTube and other platforms and reports quality and formats.

steps.zh:

description.zh: 免费 edge-tts 配音、批量试听与 ASR 转写。
description.en: Free edge-tts voiceover, batch previews and ASR transcription.

description.zh: 只用公开来源生成可溯源的公司与行业研究报告。
description.en: Produces traceable company and industry research reports from public sources only.

description.zh: 数据画像、清洗与校验并输出结构化报告，适合清洗达人名单。
description.en: Profiles, cleans and validates data with structured reports, useful for cleaning creator lists.

description.zh: 内置表格、文档与幻灯片环境，用于达人台账和结案报告。
description.en: Built-in spreadsheet, document and slide workspace for creator trackers and campaign reports.

description.zh: 在回复里内联渲染图表、表单等交互组件。
description.en: Renders charts, forms and other interactive components inline in replies.

description.zh: 把 CSV/XLSX/JSON 转成独立的交互式 ECharts HTML，支持 32 种图表。
description.en: Turns CSV, XLSX or JSON into standalone interactive ECharts HTML with 32 chart types.

steps.zh:

steps.en:
1. Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, and enter `github:hherosoul/dsh-smart-charts` (the package is not in the DSH plugin index, so it installs straight from GitHub).

description.zh: 读写 Word、Excel、PowerPoint，可插入图片。
description.en: Reads and writes Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, including images.

description.zh: 侧栏设计画布，实时预览海报、邮件和落地页的 HTML。
description.en: Sidebar design canvas with live HTML previews of posters, emails and landing pages.

description.zh: 打包网页 PPT、社媒图文卡片、网页排版等 5 个设计技能。
description.en: Bundles five design skills including web slides, social image cards and web layout.

description.zh: 对话式文生图和图生图，支持 ComfyUI 或已有的 ChatGPT/Google 订阅登录。
description.en: Conversational text-to-image and image-to-image via ComfyUI or an existing ChatGPT or Google subscription login.

setup.zh: 免费方案需要自建 ComfyUI（见 https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI ），启动后在插件设置里填写 ComfyUI 地址（默认 http://127.0.0.1:8188）；也可以改用自己的 key 或已有订阅登录。
setup.en: The free path needs a self-hosted ComfyUI (see https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI); after it starts, enter its URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8188) in the plugin settings. You can also use your own key or an existing subscription login.

description.zh: 本地内容生产工作台：选题、脚本、素材、排期、发布状态与复盘。
description.en: Local content workbench for ideas, scripts, assets, scheduling, publishing status and retrospectives.

steps.zh:

description.zh: IMAP/SMTP 邮件工具：列出、搜索、发送、回复、标记与监听新邮件。
description.en: IMAP and SMTP tools to list, search, send, reply to, flag and watch email.

setup.zh: 需要自己邮箱的 IMAP/SMTP 授权码（应用专用密码）：Gmail 在 Google 账号 → 安全 → 应用专用密码生成，其他邮箱在网页版设置中开启 IMAP/SMTP 后获取；然后在插件设置页填写。
setup.en: Requires an IMAP/SMTP app password for your own mailbox: for Gmail create one under Google Account → Security → App passwords; other providers issue one after you enable IMAP/SMTP in webmail settings. Enter it on the plugin settings page.

description.zh: 只读 IMAP 搜索加 SMTP 发信，读和发分别有开关。
description.en: Read-only IMAP search plus SMTP sending, with separate switches for reading and sending.

setup.zh: 需要邮箱的 IMAP/SMTP 授权码（应用专用密码），在邮箱网页版设置中开启 IMAP/SMTP 后生成，再填到插件设置页的凭据中。
setup.en: Requires an IMAP/SMTP app password; generate it after enabling IMAP/SMTP in your webmail settings, then store it in the plugin settings page credentials.

description.zh: 用 35 个结构化工具驱动真实 Chrome，可导入登录态。
description.en: Drives a real Chrome with 35 structured tools and can import signed-in sessions.

description.zh: Chrome 侧栏扩展，让 Agent 直接操作当前标签页，不依赖视觉。
description.en: Chrome side-panel extension that lets the agent operate the current tab without vision.

steps.zh:

1. Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, and enter `github:omdsh-dev/dsh-browser#path:packages/browser/bridge-browser` (the package is not in the DSH plugin index, so it installs straight from GitHub).
2. Install the companion Chrome side-panel extension as described in the https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser README and keep Chrome open.
3. Restart Tomato or reload the Plugins page to confirm it is enabled.

description.en: Browser runtime that bundles Playwright and OpenCLI.

setup.zh: 需要自建 SearXNG：例如 `docker run -d --name searxng -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 searxng/searxng`，并在 settings.yml 的 `search.formats` 中启用 `json`（插件仓库附 docker-compose 示例）；然后在插件设置中填写 http://127.0.0.1:8080 。
setup.en: Requires a self-hosted SearXNG, for example `docker run -d --name searxng -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 searxng/searxng`, with `json` enabled under `search.formats` in settings.yml (the plugin repository ships a docker-compose example). Then enter http://127.0.0.1:8080 in the plugin settings.

description.zh: 拉取 YouTube 视频的字幕和转录。
description.en: Fetches captions and transcripts for YouTube videos.

description.zh: 获取 YouTube 转录，长视频可分页读取。
description.en: Retrieves YouTube transcripts with pagination for long videos.

description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载字幕，供模型总结视频。
description.en: Downloads subtitles with yt-dlp so the model can summarize videos.

setup.zh: 需要本机已安装 yt-dlp（macOS：`brew install yt-dlp`；其他系统见 https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation ）。
setup.en: Requires yt-dlp on the machine (macOS: `brew install yt-dlp`; other systems see https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation).

description.zh: 基于 yt-dlp 读取视频和音频元数据、字幕，并支持下载与搜索。
description.en: Reads video and audio metadata and subtitles and supports downloads and search through yt-dlp.

setup.zh: 需要本机已安装 yt-dlp（macOS：`brew install yt-dlp`；其他系统见 https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation ）；需要登录才能看的视频可选配浏览器 cookie。
setup.en: Requires yt-dlp on the machine (macOS: `brew install yt-dlp`; other systems see https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation); videos that need sign-in can optionally use browser cookies.

description.zh: 为 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、X 的单条视频提取转录、元数据、评论与关键帧。
description.en: Extracts transcripts, metadata, comments and key frames from single YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or X videos.

setup.zh: 需要本机已安装 yt-dlp（macOS：`brew install yt-dlp`；其他系统见 https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation ），抽帧需要 ffmpeg（`brew install ffmpeg`）；没有字幕时可装本地 whisper（`pip install openai-whisper`）作为转写兜底。
setup.en: Requires yt-dlp on the machine (macOS: `brew install yt-dlp`; other systems see https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation); frame extraction needs ffmpeg (`brew install ffmpeg`); for videos without captions install local whisper (`pip install openai-whisper`) as the transcription fallback.

description.zh: 抽帧加音频转写，让模型“看懂”视频。
description.en: Extracts frames and transcribes audio so the model can understand videos.

setup.zh: 需要 ffmpeg（`brew install ffmpeg`）和本地 whisper（如 `brew install whisper-cpp`）；也可改用 Gemini 免费档：到 https://aistudio.google.com/apikey 申请 key 并设置 `GEMINI_API_KEY`。
setup.en: Requires ffmpeg (`brew install ffmpeg`) and a local whisper (such as `brew install whisper-cpp`); alternatively use the Gemini free tier by creating a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey and setting `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

description.zh: YouTube 全流程 CLI 与 MCP：上传、元数据、播放列表、评论与频道数据。
description.en: YouTube CLI and MCP for uploads, metadata, playlists, comments and channel data.

setup.zh: 在 Google Cloud Console 创建项目并启用 YouTube Data API v3，创建 OAuth 客户端（桌面应用）并下载 `client_secret.json`；按 yutu README 完成授权生成 `youtube.token.json`，再把两个文件的绝对路径分别设为环境变量 `YUTU_CREDENTIAL` 和 `YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN`。
setup.en: Create a Google Cloud project, enable YouTube Data API v3, create a desktop OAuth client and download `client_secret.json`; complete authorization per the yutu README to produce `youtube.token.json`, then set the absolute paths of the two files as `YUTU_CREDENTIAL` and `YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN`.

steps.zh:
1. 安装 yutu 可执行文件：`brew install yutu`，或 `npm i -g @eat-pray-ai/yutu@0.11.0`（也可用 `docker pull ghcr.io/eat-pray-ai/yutu:latest`）。
2. 按上面的说明准备 `client_secret.json` 与 `youtube.token.json`，并在启动 Tomato 的环境里设置 `YUTU_CREDENTIAL`、`YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN`。
3. 在终端运行 `yutu mcp --help` 确认可用。
4. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-yutu
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-yutu
        transport: stdio
        command: yutu
        args: ['mcp']
        env:
          YUTU_CREDENTIAL: !!js process.env.YUTU_CREDENTIAL
          YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN: !!js process.env.YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN
```
steps.en:
1. Install the yutu executable: `brew install yutu` or `npm i -g @eat-pray-ai/yutu@0.11.0` (or `docker pull ghcr.io/eat-pray-ai/yutu:latest`).
2. Prepare `client_secret.json` and `youtube.token.json` as described above and set `YUTU_CREDENTIAL` and `YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN` in the environment that launches Tomato.
3. Run `yutu mcp --help` in a terminal to confirm it works.
4. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-yutu
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-yutu
        transport: stdio
        command: yutu
        args: ['mcp']
        env:
          YUTU_CREDENTIAL: !!js process.env.YUTU_CREDENTIAL
          YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN: !!js process.env.YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN
```

description.zh: 通过 YouTube Data API 读取视频、频道、播放列表与统计数据，适合核验达人频道。
description.en: Reads videos, channels, playlists and statistics through the YouTube Data API, useful for verifying creator channels.

setup.zh: 在 Google Cloud Console 启用 YouTube Data API v3 并创建 API key（免费配额每天 10,000 单位），设置环境变量 `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`。
setup.en: Enable YouTube Data API v3 in Google Cloud Console and create an API key (the free quota is 10,000 units per day), then set `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`.

description.zh: 通用内容读取，覆盖 X、YouTube、网页等 10 多个平台。
description.en: Reads content from X, YouTube, web pages and more than ten other platforms.

setup.zh: 需要先安装 uv（https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/ ）。视频转写可选：安装 yt-dlp，并到 https://console.groq.com/keys 申请免费 key 设为 `GROQ_API_KEY`。
setup.en: Install uv first (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/). Optional video transcription: install yt-dlp and set `GROQ_API_KEY` with a free key from https://console.groq.com/keys.

steps.zh:
1. 安装 uv：`curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`。
2. 先在终端试跑一次（该包未发布到 PyPI，只能从 GitHub 源码运行）：`uvx --with "mcp[cli]>=1.0,<2" --from git+https://github.com/runesleo/x-reader.git x-reader-mcp`，看到等待 stdio 输入后按 Ctrl+C 退出。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-x-reader
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-x-reader
        transport: stdio
        command: uvx
        args: ['--with', 'mcp[cli]>=1.0,<2', '--from', 'git+https://github.com/runesleo/x-reader.git', 'x-reader-mcp']
```
steps.en:
1. Install uv: `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`.
2. Do a trial run in a terminal (the package is not on PyPI and runs only from GitHub source): `uvx --with "mcp[cli]>=1.0,<2" --from git+https://github.com/runesleo/x-reader.git x-reader-mcp`; when it waits on stdio, press Ctrl+C.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-x-reader
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-x-reader
        transport: stdio
        command: uvx
        args: ['--with', 'mcp[cli]>=1.0,<2', '--from', 'git+https://github.com/runesleo/x-reader.git', 'x-reader-mcp']
```

description.zh: 自托管 TikTok 数据 API：帖子、作者、评论、话题、榜单与搜索，并内置 MCP。
description.en: Self-hosted TikTok data API for posts, authors, comments, hashtags, rankings and search, with a built-in MCP endpoint.

setup.zh: 需要 Docker 与 Docker Compose 自建服务（自动维护访客身份池，无需付费 key）。部署后在控制台创建带所需 scope 的 API key（`dtk_` 开头），设置环境变量 `DTK_API_KEY`。
setup.en: Requires a Docker Compose deployment (it maintains a visitor identity pool, no paid key). After deployment create an API key with the needed scopes (starting with `dtk_`) in the console and set `DTK_API_KEY`.

steps.zh:
1. 克隆仓库：`git clone https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API.git && cd Douyin_TikTok_Download_API`。
2. 按仓库 `documents/en/02-installation.md` 复制 `.env` 示例并填好 `DTK_SECRET_KEY`、数据库与 Redis 密码，然后运行 `docker compose up -d`。
3. 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8000 注册管理员，在 API keys 页面创建 key，并在启动 Tomato 的环境里设置 `DTK_API_KEY`。
4. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-douyin-tiktok-api
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-douyin-tiktok-api
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.DTK_API_KEY}`'
```
steps.en:
1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API.git && cd Douyin_TikTok_Download_API`.
2. Following `documents/en/02-installation.md`, copy the `.env` example, fill in `DTK_SECRET_KEY` and the database and Redis passwords, then run `docker compose up -d`.
3. Open http://127.0.0.1:8000, register the admin account, create a key on the API keys page and set `DTK_API_KEY` in the environment that launches Tomato.
4. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-douyin-tiktok-api

      config:
        serverName: mkt-douyin-tiktok-api
```


description.zh: X/Twitter 抓取工具包和 MCP：资料、推文、搜索与粉丝。
description.en: X/Twitter scraping toolkit and MCP for profiles, posts, search and followers.

setup.zh: 资料和推文免登录；搜索、粉丝等需要你自己的 X 登录 cookie：登录 x.com 后在开发者工具 → Application → Cookies 复制 `auth_token`，设为环境变量 `XACTIONS_SESSION_COOKIE`（也可运行 `npx xactions login --from-browser` 从本机浏览器导入）。建议用小号，存在封号风险。
setup.en: Profiles and posts work without sign-in; search and followers need your own X session cookie: sign in to x.com, copy `auth_token` from DevTools → Application → Cookies and set it as `XACTIONS_SESSION_COOKIE` (or run `npx xactions login --from-browser` to import it from a local browser). Use a secondary account; accounts can be restricted.

description.zh: 用真实浏览器会话调研 X 资料、收件箱与帖子，发布和私信需草稿审批。
description.en: Researches X profiles, inboxes and posts through a real browser session, with draft approval before posting or messaging.

setup.zh: 需要你自己的 X 登录 cookie。先选一个私有数据目录并设为环境变量 `X_USE_HOME`（如 `~/.local/share/x-use`），然后运行 `uvx --from x-use-mcp==3.2.0 patchright install chromium` 安装浏览器，再运行 `uvx --from x-use-mcp==3.2.0 x-use init` 导入自己导出的 X cookie JSON，最后 `x-use doctor` 自检。存在封号风险，建议用小号。
setup.en: Needs your own X session cookies. Choose a private data directory and set it as `X_USE_HOME` (for example `~/.local/share/x-use`), run `uvx --from x-use-mcp==3.2.0 patchright install chromium` to install the browser, then `uvx --from x-use-mcp==3.2.0 x-use init` to import your exported X cookie JSON, and `x-use doctor` to check. Accounts can be restricted; use a secondary account.

description.zh: 读取 LinkedIn 人员、公司、职位与消息。
description.en: Reads LinkedIn people, companies, jobs and messages.

setup.en: Needs your own LinkedIn session. Install uv, then run `uvx mcp-server-linkedin@4.29.0 --login` and sign in in the browser window (or use `--import-from-browser` to reuse a local browser session); the session lives in `~/.linkedin-mcp/` and must be renewed when it expires. Accounts can be restricted.

description.zh: LinkedIn 搜人、搜公司与抓取资料。

setup.en: Requires Python 3.12+, uv and your own LinkedIn account; on first use run `uv run linkedin-mcp-server --login` to sign in and save the session. Accounts can be restricted.

steps.zh:
1. 该项目未发布到 PyPI（PyPI 上同名的 `linkedin-mcp-server` 是另一个作者的项目），需从源码运行。安装 uv 后执行 `git clone https://github.com/eliasbiondo/linkedin-mcp-server.git ~/linkedin-mcp-server && cd ~/linkedin-mcp-server && uv sync`。
2. 运行 `uv run linkedin-mcp-server --login` 在弹出的浏览器中登录 LinkedIn。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-linkedin-eliasbiondo
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-linkedin-eliasbiondo
        transport: stdio
        command: uv
        args: ['--directory', '/absolute/path/to/linkedin-mcp-server', 'run', 'linkedin-mcp-server']
```
steps.en:
1. This project is not on PyPI (the PyPI package named `linkedin-mcp-server` belongs to another author), so run it from source. After installing uv, run `git clone https://github.com/eliasbiondo/linkedin-mcp-server.git ~/linkedin-mcp-server && cd ~/linkedin-mcp-server && uv sync`.
2. Run `uv run linkedin-mcp-server --login` and sign in to LinkedIn in the browser window.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-linkedin-eliasbiondo
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-linkedin-eliasbiondo

        command: uv

```

description.zh: 用 Instagram Graph API 读写自有商业号的帖子、洞察、评论与私信。
description.en: Reads and manages posts, insights, comments and messages on your own Instagram business account through the Graph API.

setup.zh: 需要 Instagram 商业号或创作者号并关联 Facebook 主页；到 https://developers.facebook.com 创建 app，生成长期访问令牌，设置 `INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN`、`INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID`，以及刷新令牌用的 `FACEBOOK_APP_ID`、`FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET`。
setup.en: Requires an Instagram business or creator account linked to a Facebook Page; create an app at https://developers.facebook.com, generate a long-lived token and set `INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID`, plus `FACEBOOK_APP_ID` and `FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET` for token refresh.

steps.zh:
1. 该项目未发布到 PyPI，需要 Python 3.10+ 从源码运行：`git clone https://github.com/jlbadano/ig-mcp.git ~/ig-mcp && cd ~/ig-mcp && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`。
2. 按上面的说明取得令牌，并在启动 Tomato 的环境里设置这些环境变量。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-ig-mcp
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'

        serverName: mkt-ig-mcp
        transport: stdio
        command: /absolute/path/to/ig-mcp/.venv/bin/python
        args: ['/absolute/path/to/ig-mcp/src/instagram_mcp_server.py']
        env:
          INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN: !!js process.env.INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN
          INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID: !!js process.env.INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID
          FACEBOOK_APP_ID: !!js process.env.FACEBOOK_APP_ID
          FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET: !!js process.env.FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET
```
steps.en:
1. This project is not on PyPI and runs from source with Python 3.10+: `git clone https://github.com/jlbadano/ig-mcp.git ~/ig-mcp && cd ~/ig-mcp && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`.
2. Obtain the tokens as described above and set these environment variables where Tomato is launched.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
        args: ['/absolute/path/to/ig-mcp/src/instagram_mcp_server.py']
        env:
          INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN: !!js process.env.INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN
          INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID: !!js process.env.INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID
          FACEBOOK_APP_ID: !!js process.env.FACEBOOK_APP_ID
          FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET: !!js process.env.FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET
```

description.zh: Google 官方 GA4 数据 MCP。
description.en: Google's official MCP for GA4 data.

setup.zh: 在 Google Cloud 项目中启用 Google Analytics Admin API 和 Data API，用 `gcloud auth application-default login --scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform` 生成应用默认凭据，把凭据 JSON 路径设为 `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`，项目 ID 设为 `GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID`。
setup.en: Enable the Google Analytics Admin and Data APIs in a Google Cloud project, create application default credentials with `gcloud auth application-default login --scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform`, set the credentials JSON path as `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` and the project ID as `GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID`.

description.zh: Google Search Console 查询、URL 检查与站点地图管理。
description.en: Google Search Console queries, URL inspection and sitemap management.

setup.zh: 在 Google Cloud Console 启用 Search Console API，创建 OAuth 客户端（桌面应用）并下载 JSON，把绝对路径设为 `GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS_FILE`；首次调用会打开浏览器授权。需要 Python 3.11+（uvx 会自动管理）。
setup.en: Enable the Search Console API in Google Cloud Console, create a desktop OAuth client, download its JSON and set the absolute path as `GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS_FILE`; the first call opens a browser for consent. Requires Python 3.11+ (uvx manages it).

title.zh: Search Console 与 Bing 站长

description.zh: 读取 Google Search Console 与 Bing Webmaster 数据。
description.en: Reads Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools data.

setup.en: Run `npx search-console-mcp@2.1.4 setup` once to complete Google OAuth; for Bing data create an API key at https://www.bing.com/webmasters/settings/api and set `BING_API_KEY`.

description.zh: 用自己的凭据接入 GSC、GA4、PageSpeed，在本地运行 SEO 工作流。

setup.zh: 先在终端运行一次 `uvx seo-monster@0.9.3 auth` 完成 Google 登录；PageSpeed 数据需在 Google Cloud Console 创建免费 API key 并设为 `PSI_API_KEY`。
setup.en: Run `uvx seo-monster@0.9.3 auth` once in a terminal to sign in with Google; PageSpeed data needs a free API key from Google Cloud Console set as `PSI_API_KEY`.

description.zh: 自托管的 Google、Bing、DuckDuckGo 等 SERP 抓取，返回结构化 JSON。
description.en: Self-hosted SERP scraping for Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and others, returning structured JSON.

setup.zh: 需要先用 Docker 启动 OpenSERP 服务：`docker run -d --name openserp -p 127.0.0.1:7000:7000 karust/openserp serve -a 0.0.0.0 -p 7000`；服务不在本机默认地址时设置 `OPENSERP_BASE_URL`。
setup.en: Start the OpenSERP service with Docker first: `docker run -d --name openserp -p 127.0.0.1:7000:7000 karust/openserp serve -a 0.0.0.0 -p 7000`; set `OPENSERP_BASE_URL` when the service is not at the local default.


2. Verify: `curl "http://127.0.0.1:7000/google/search?text=test"` returns JSON.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml

    - id: mkt-openserp
```

description.zh: 用 310 多条规则审计网站的 SEO、性能与可访问性。
description.en: Audits websites for SEO, performance and accessibility with more than 310 rules.

steps.zh:
1. 本地审计不需要账号：`npx squirrelscan@0.0.160 audit example.com`，或 `npm i -g squirrelscan@0.0.160` 后使用 `squirrel audit example.com`。
2. MCP：README 只给出托管端点 https://mcp.squirrelscan.com/mcp （云渲染需登录），本地 stdio 启动命令未在 README 中写明，请运行 `squirrel --help` 查看是否有 `mcp` 子命令，再按下面格式接入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-squirrelscan
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-squirrelscan
        transport: stdio
        command: squirrel
        args: ['mcp']
```

3. 不想用 MCP 时，直接让 Agent 通过 shell 调用 `squirrel audit` 也能完成审计。
steps.en:
1. Local audits need no account: `npx squirrelscan@0.0.160 audit example.com`, or `npm i -g squirrelscan@0.0.160` and run `squirrel audit example.com`.
2. MCP: the README documents only the hosted endpoint https://mcp.squirrelscan.com/mcp (cloud rendering needs sign-in) and no local stdio command; run `squirrel --help` to check for an `mcp` subcommand, then connect it in this form:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-squirrelscan
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-squirrelscan
        transport: stdio
        command: squirrel
        args: ['mcp']
```

3. Without MCP, the agent can run `squirrel audit` through the shell.

steps.zh:
1. 从 https://github.com/hangwin/mcp-chrome/releases 下载扩展包，解压后在 `chrome://extensions` 打开开发者模式并“加载已解压的扩展程序”。
2. 全局安装桥接程序：`npm install -g mcp-chrome-bridge@1.0.31`（若未自动注册，运行 `mcp-chrome-bridge register`）。
3. 点击扩展图标并 Connect，本地服务监听 http://127.0.0.1:12306/mcp 。
4. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-mcp-chrome
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-mcp-chrome
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:12306/mcp
```
steps.en:
1. Download the extension from https://github.com/hangwin/mcp-chrome/releases, unzip it, enable Developer mode at `chrome://extensions` and choose Load unpacked.
2. Install the bridge globally: `npm install -g mcp-chrome-bridge@1.0.31` (if it does not register itself, run `mcp-chrome-bridge register`).
3. Click the extension icon and Connect; the local service listens on http://127.0.0.1:12306/mcp.
4. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-mcp-chrome
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-mcp-chrome
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:12306/mcp
```

description.zh: 抗反爬抓取框架，自带 MCP 服务器。
description.en: Anti-bot-resistant scraping framework with a built-in MCP server.

steps.zh:
1. MCP 功能需要 `scrapling[ai]` 额外依赖，普通的 `uvx scrapling` 不包含，因此需手动指定。安装 uv 后先下载浏览器：`uvx --from "scrapling[ai]==0.5" scrapling install`。
2. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-scrapling
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-scrapling
        transport: stdio
        command: uvx
        args: ['--from', 'scrapling[ai]==0.5', 'scrapling-mcp']
```
steps.en:
1. The MCP feature needs the `scrapling[ai]` extra, which a plain `uvx scrapling` lacks, so it must be specified manually. After installing uv, download the browsers: `uvx --from "scrapling[ai]==0.5" scrapling install`.
2. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-scrapling
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-scrapling
        transport: stdio
        command: uvx
        args: ['--from', 'scrapling[ai]==0.5', 'scrapling-mcp']
```

description.zh: 把网站抓成 LLM 可用的 Markdown，自托管服务带 MCP。
description.en: Crawls websites into LLM-ready Markdown, with MCP in the self-hosted server.

setup.zh: 需要 Docker 自建服务，并生成访问令牌设为 `CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN`（例如 `export CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"`）。
setup.en: Requires a self-hosted Docker service with an access token set as `CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN` (for example `export CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"`).

steps.zh:
1. 启动服务：`docker run -d -p 11235:11235 --name crawl4ai --shm-size=1g -e CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN="$CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN" unclecode/crawl4ai:latest`。
2. 验证：打开 http://localhost:11235/playground 。MCP 端点以 https://docs.crawl4ai.com/core/self-hosting/ 为准（当前为 SSE 端点 `/mcp/sse`），Tomato 只支持 stdio 和 streamable HTTP，因此用 `mcp-remote` 桥接。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-crawl4ai
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-crawl4ai
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'mcp-remote@0.16.0', 'http://localhost:11235/mcp/sse', '--transport', 'sse-only', '--header', 'Authorization:Bearer ${CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN}']
        env:
          CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN: !!js process.env.CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN
```
steps.en:
1. Start the service: `docker run -d -p 11235:11235 --name crawl4ai --shm-size=1g -e CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN="$CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN" unclecode/crawl4ai:latest`.
2. Verify by opening http://localhost:11235/playground. Check the MCP endpoint at https://docs.crawl4ai.com/core/self-hosting/ (currently the SSE endpoint `/mcp/sse`); Tomato supports only stdio and streamable HTTP, so bridge it with `mcp-remote`.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-crawl4ai
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-crawl4ai
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'mcp-remote@0.16.0', 'http://localhost:11235/mcp/sse', '--transport', 'sse-only', '--header', 'Authorization:Bearer ${CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN}']
        env:
          CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN: !!js process.env.CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN
```

description.zh: 用 Playwright 抓取需要 JS 渲染的页面。
description.en: Fetches JavaScript-rendered pages with Playwright.

setup.zh: 首次使用前运行 `npx playwright install chromium` 下载浏览器。
setup.en: Run `npx playwright install chromium` once to download the browser.

description.zh: 本地优先的搜索、抓取、爬取与研究，无需 key。
description.en: Local-first search, fetching, crawling and research without a key.

setup.zh: 首次使用前运行 `npx wigolo@0.3.1 init` 初始化本地引擎；research 汇总可选配 Gemini 免费 key（https://aistudio.google.com/apikey ，设为 `GEMINI_API_KEY`）。
setup.en: Run `npx wigolo@0.3.1 init` once to set up the local engine; research summaries can optionally use a free Gemini key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey, set as `GEMINI_API_KEY`).

description.zh: 开源社媒排期平台，覆盖 30 多个渠道，自带 MCP 和 CLI。
description.en: Open-source social media scheduler for more than 30 channels with built-in MCP and CLI.

setup.zh: 需要 Docker 自建 Postiz（Postgres、Redis、存储），各平台的 OAuth app 需自己免费申请；见 https://docs.postiz.com/installation 。
setup.en: Requires a self-hosted Postiz on Docker (Postgres, Redis and storage) plus free OAuth apps you register on each platform; see https://docs.postiz.com/installation.

steps.zh:
1. 按 https://docs.postiz.com/installation 用 Docker Compose 部署 Postiz，并在 `.env` 中配置各平台 OAuth app。
2. 登录 Postiz，在 Settings → Public API 生成 API key，复制设置页给出的 MCP 地址，替换下面的 URL（以设置页显示为准）。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-postiz
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-postiz
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://localhost:5000/api/mcp/<YOUR_POSTIZ_API_KEY>
```
steps.en:
1. Deploy Postiz with Docker Compose per https://docs.postiz.com/installation and configure each platform OAuth app in `.env`.
2. Sign in to Postiz, create an API key under Settings → Public API, copy the MCP URL shown there and replace the URL below (the settings page is authoritative).
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-postiz
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-postiz
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://localhost:5000/api/mcp/<YOUR_POSTIZ_API_KEY>
```

description.zh: 面向 Agent 的开源社媒排期工具，MCP 有 80 多个工具。
description.en: Agent-oriented open-source social scheduler whose MCP server exposes more than 80 tools.

setup.zh: 需要自建 TryPost 实例（见 https://docs.trypost.it ），在实例中创建 API token 后设为 `TRYPOST_API_TOKEN`。
setup.en: Requires a self-hosted TryPost instance (see https://docs.trypost.it); create an API token in the instance and set it as `TRYPOST_API_TOKEN`.

steps.zh:
1. 按 https://github.com/trypostit/trypost 的 README 与 https://docs.trypost.it 部署实例。
2. 按 https://docs.trypost.it/ai/introduction 在实例中创建 API token，并把文档给出的 MCP 地址填到下面的 URL。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-trypost
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-trypost
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://<your-trypost-host>/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.TRYPOST_API_TOKEN}`'
```
steps.en:
1. Deploy an instance per the https://github.com/trypostit/trypost README and https://docs.trypost.it.
2. Create an API token per https://docs.trypost.it/ai/introduction and put the MCP URL from that page into the URL below.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-trypost
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-trypost
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://<your-trypost-host>/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.TRYPOST_API_TOKEN}`'
```

description.zh: 多客户社媒管理：排期、发布、收件箱与分析，带 REST 与 MCP 接口。
description.en: Multi-client social media management for scheduling, publishing, inbox and analytics with REST and MCP APIs.

setup.zh: 需要 Docker 自建（也有免费托管版 https://brightbean.xyz/studio/ ）；在实例中生成 API token 后设为 `BRIGHTBEAN_API_TOKEN`。
setup.en: Requires a Docker self-hosted deployment (a free hosted version is at https://brightbean.xyz/studio/); create an API token in the instance and set it as `BRIGHTBEAN_API_TOKEN`.

steps.zh:
1. `git clone https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio.git && cd brightbean-studio && cp .env.example .env`，把 `DATABASE_URL` 改为 `postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/brightbean`。
2. `docker compose up -d --build`，再 `docker compose exec app python manage.py createsuperuser`，打开 http://localhost:8000 登录。
3. 在设置中生成 API token，按仓库 README 的 MCP 章节确认 MCP 地址并填到下面的 URL。
4. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-brightbean-studio
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-brightbean-studio
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://localhost:8000/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.BRIGHTBEAN_API_TOKEN}`'
```
steps.en:
1. `git clone https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio.git && cd brightbean-studio && cp .env.example .env`, then set `DATABASE_URL` to `postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/brightbean`.
2. Run `docker compose up -d --build`, then `docker compose exec app python manage.py createsuperuser`, and sign in at http://localhost:8000.
3. Create an API token in settings, confirm the MCP URL in the README MCP section and put it into the URL below.
4. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-brightbean-studio
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-brightbean-studio
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://localhost:8000/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.BRIGHTBEAN_API_TOKEN}`'
```

description.zh: 多账号 IMAP/SMTP 邮件：读取、搜索、整理与发信。
description.en: Multi-account IMAP and SMTP email for reading, searching, organizing and sending.

setup.zh: 需要邮箱的 IMAP/SMTP 授权码（应用专用密码）。先运行 `uvx mcp-email-server@1.14.0 ui` 在浏览器中添加邮箱账号并保存，再接入。
setup.en: Requires an IMAP/SMTP app password for each mailbox. Run `uvx mcp-email-server@1.14.0 ui` first to add and save the accounts in the browser, then connect.

description.zh: Gmail、日历、Docs、Sheets、Drive 一体化 MCP。
description.en: One MCP server for Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Drive.

setup.zh: 在 Google Cloud Console 启用所需 API（Gmail、Drive、Calendar、Sheets、Docs），创建 OAuth 客户端（桌面应用），把 Client ID 和 Secret 设为 `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`、`GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET`；首次调用会打开浏览器授权。
setup.en: Enable the needed APIs (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Docs) in Google Cloud Console, create a desktop OAuth client and set its ID and secret as `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET`; the first call opens a browser for consent.

description.zh: 通过 Thunderbird 读写邮件、联系人与日历。
description.en: Reads and writes mail, contacts and calendars through Thunderbird.

steps.zh:
1. 从 https://github.com/TKasperczyk/thunderbird-mcp/releases 下载 `.xpi`，在 Thunderbird 的“附加组件和主题”中“从文件安装附加组件”，并保持 Thunderbird 运行。
2. 克隆仓库以获得 stdio 桥接脚本：`git clone https://github.com/TKasperczyk/thunderbird-mcp.git ~/thunderbird-mcp`（需要 Node.js）。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-thunderbird-mcp
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-thunderbird-mcp
        transport: stdio
        command: node
        args: ['/absolute/path/to/thunderbird-mcp/mcp-bridge.cjs']
```
steps.en:
1. Download the `.xpi` from https://github.com/TKasperczyk/thunderbird-mcp/releases, install it in Thunderbird via Add-ons and Themes → Install Add-on From File, and keep Thunderbird running.
2. Clone the repository for the stdio bridge script: `git clone https://github.com/TKasperczyk/thunderbird-mcp.git ~/thunderbird-mcp` (requires Node.js).
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-thunderbird-mcp
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-thunderbird-mcp
        transport: stdio
        command: node
        args: ['/absolute/path/to/thunderbird-mcp/mcp-bridge.cjs']
```

description.zh: 访问 macOS Apple Mail：读取、搜索、写信与整理。
description.en: Accesses macOS Apple Mail to read, search, compose and organize mail.

setup.zh: 仅支持 macOS，需要 Apple Mail 已配置账号；首次调用时在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 自动化”中允许终端或 Tomato 控制 Mail。
setup.en: macOS only and needs accounts configured in Apple Mail; on first use allow Terminal or Tomato to control Mail under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.

description.zh: Resend 官方发信 MCP，支持批量外联和联系人管理。
description.en: Official Resend MCP for bulk outreach email and contact management.

setup.zh: 到 https://resend.com 注册免费档，验证发信域名后在 API Keys 页面创建 key，设为 `RESEND_API_KEY`。
setup.en: Sign up for the free tier at https://resend.com, verify a sending domain, create a key on the API Keys page and set it as `RESEND_API_KEY`.

description.zh: AntV 出品，生成 25 种以上图表。
description.en: Generates more than 25 chart types, from AntV.

description.zh: 创建和编辑 Excel，支持图表、透视表与公式。
description.en: Creates and edits Excel workbooks with charts, pivot tables and formulas.

description.zh: 读写 Google Sheets，用于达人台账协作。
description.en: Reads and writes Google Sheets for shared creator trackers.

setup.zh: 推荐服务账号：在 Google Cloud Console 启用 Sheets API 和 Drive API，创建服务账号并下载 JSON key，设 `SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH` 为其路径；在 Drive 中建一个文件夹共享给服务账号邮箱，把文件夹 ID 设为 `DRIVE_FOLDER_ID`。
setup.en: Service account recommended: enable the Sheets and Drive APIs in Google Cloud Console, create a service account, download its JSON key and set `SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH`; share a Drive folder with the service account email and set its ID as `DRIVE_FOLDER_ID`.

description.zh: Notion 官方 MCP，可用作达人 CRM 和内容日历。
description.en: Official Notion MCP for a creator CRM and content calendar.

setup.zh: 到 https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations 创建内部 integration，复制 token 设为 `NOTION_TOKEN`，并在需要的页面里把该 integration 加为连接。
setup.en: Create an internal integration at https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations, set its token as `NOTION_TOKEN` and add the integration as a connection on the pages it needs.

description.zh: 通过 Shopify Admin API 管理商品、订单、客户与折扣。
description.en: Manages products, orders, customers and discounts through the Shopify Admin API.

setup.zh: 在 Shopify Dev Dashboard 创建 app 并安装到店铺，取得 Client ID 和 Secret，设置 `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID`、`SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` 和 `MYSHOPIFY_DOMAIN`（如 your-store.myshopify.com）。
setup.en: Create an app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard, install it on the store, and set `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID`, `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` and `MYSHOPIFY_DOMAIN` (such as your-store.myshopify.com).

description.zh: WordPress 官方 MCP 适配器，适用于内容站和 WooCommerce。
description.en: Official WordPress MCP adapter for content sites and WooCommerce.

setup.zh: 需要你自己的 WordPress 站点（6.9+，含 Abilities API）和可执行 WP-CLI 的环境；在站点安装 MCP Adapter 插件，并为要暴露的 ability 设置 `meta.public`。
setup.en: Requires your own WordPress site (6.9+ with the Abilities API) and a host where WP-CLI runs; install the MCP Adapter plugin on the site and set `meta.public` on the abilities to expose.

steps.zh:
1. 在 WordPress 站点目录运行 `composer require wordpress/mcp-adapter`，或从 https://github.com/WordPress/mcp-adapter/releases 下载插件 zip 在后台上传启用。
2. 按 https://github.com/WordPress/mcp-adapter/tree/trunk/docs 把需要的 ability 标为公开，并确认 `wp mcp-adapter list` 能列出默认服务器。
3. 本机可直接访问站点目录时用下面的 WP-CLI stdio 方式接入（远程站点改用 `/wp-json/mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server` 的 HTTP 方式并配置应用密码）。
4. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-wordpress-mcp-adapter
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-wordpress-mcp-adapter
        transport: stdio
        command: wp
        args: ['--path=/absolute/path/to/wordpress', 'mcp-adapter', 'serve', '--server=mcp-adapter-default-server', '--user=admin']
```
steps.en:
1. In the WordPress directory run `composer require wordpress/mcp-adapter`, or download the plugin zip from https://github.com/WordPress/mcp-adapter/releases and upload and activate it in the admin.
2. Mark the abilities you need as public per https://github.com/WordPress/mcp-adapter/tree/trunk/docs and confirm `wp mcp-adapter list` lists the default server.
3. When the site directory is on this machine, connect with the WP-CLI stdio form below (for a remote site use HTTP at `/wp-json/mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server` with an application password).
4. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-wordpress-mcp-adapter
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-wordpress-mcp-adapter
        transport: stdio
        command: wp
        args: ['--path=/absolute/path/to/wordpress', 'mcp-adapter', 'serve', '--server=mcp-adapter-default-server', '--user=admin']
```

description.zh: 42 个本地 FFmpeg 剪辑工具（字幕、裁切、竖版等），同时提供 MCP 和 Skill。
description.en: Forty-two local FFmpeg editing tools for captions, trimming, vertical formats and more, available as MCP and a skill.

setup.zh: 需要本机安装 ffmpeg/ffprobe（`brew install ffmpeg`）和 Python 3；运行 `npx ffmpeg-skill@3.1.1 doctor` 检查依赖。
setup.en: Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe (`brew install ffmpeg`) and Python 3; run `npx ffmpeg-skill@3.1.1 doctor` to check dependencies.

steps.zh:
1. npm 包的可执行文件只是安装器，MCP 服务器是安装后的 Python 脚本。运行 `npx ffmpeg-skill@3.1.1`，它会把技能装到 `~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill`。
2. 运行 `npx ffmpeg-skill@3.1.1 doctor` 确认 ffmpeg 可用。
3. 把下面这段加到 `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（桌面端的 `<profile>` 是 `desktop`，网页端是 `web`），保存后新开会话即可看到 `mcp__mkt-…__*` 工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-ffmpeg-skill
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-ffmpeg-skill
        transport: stdio
        command: python3
        args: ['/absolute/path/to/home/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill/mcp/server.py']
```
steps.en:
1. The npm executable is only an installer; the MCP server is the installed Python script. Run `npx ffmpeg-skill@3.1.1`, which installs the skill into `~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill`.
2. Run `npx ffmpeg-skill@3.1.1 doctor` to confirm ffmpeg is available.
3. Add this block to `$TOMATO_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`<profile>` is `desktop` in the desktop app and `web` in the web app), then start a new session to see the `mcp__mkt-…__*` tools:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mkt-ffmpeg-skill
      name: '@tomato/mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: mkt-ffmpeg-skill
        transport: stdio
        command: python3
        args: ['/absolute/path/to/home/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill/mcp/server.py']
```

steps.zh:
1. 该仓库超过 jsDelivr 的 50 MB 列表上限，无法自动锁定子技能目录，需手动安装。

3. 在仓库里找到含 `SKILL.md` 的目录（`find /tmp/ecommerce-ai-skills -name SKILL.md`），把需要的目录复制到项目的 `.agents/skills/` 下。
4. 新开会话，确认技能出现在技能列表中。
steps.en:
1. The repository exceeds the jsDelivr 50 MB listing limit, so sub-skill directories cannot be pinned automatically; install manually.
2. Clone it: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kangise/ecommerce-ai-skills.git /tmp/ecommerce-ai-skills`.
3. Find the directories that contain `SKILL.md` (`find /tmp/ecommerce-ai-skills -name SKILL.md`) and copy the ones you need into the project `.agents/skills/` directory.
4. Start a new session and confirm the skills appear in the skill list.

steps.zh:
1. 该仓库超过 jsDelivr 的 50 MB 列表上限，无法自动锁定子技能目录，需手动安装。
2. 安装 CLI：`npm i -g hyperframes@0.9.8`，并安装 ffmpeg。
3. 克隆仓库：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git /tmp/hyperframes`，用 `find /tmp/hyperframes -name SKILL.md -not -path "*/node_modules/*"` 找到技能目录，复制到项目的 `.agents/skills/` 下（或在支持的环境运行 `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes`）。

steps.en:
1. The repository exceeds the jsDelivr 50 MB listing limit, so sub-skill directories cannot be pinned automatically; install manually.
2. Install the CLI: `npm i -g hyperframes@0.9.8`, and install ffmpeg.
3. Clone it: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git /tmp/hyperframes`, find the skill directories with `find /tmp/hyperframes -name SKILL.md -not -path "*/node_modules/*"` and copy them into the project `.agents/skills/` directory (or run `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes` where supported).
4. Start a new session and confirm the skills appear in the skill list.
